title: Nylas notetaker.deleted notification object
description: Sent when a Notetaker bot is deleted, its associated event is cancelled, or its settings are set to null. This schema describes `data.object` inside the Nylas notification envelope.

id.description: Unique identifier for the deleted Notetaker bot.

grant_id.description: The grant ID that owned this Notetaker.

event.description: Calendar event that was associated with this Notetaker.

ical_uid.description: iCalendar UID of the associated event.

event_id.description: Nylas event ID of the associated event.

master_event_id.description: Master event ID for recurring events.
